messages.text: maybe i just wanna feel something, anything.

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: or just get over it. sounds easy, but it is.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: we're here for u, don’t forget that.

messages.text: nobody cares. stop pretending they do.

messages.text: i just want to be seen and heard for once.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: whatever, keep crying over nothing.

messages.text: it’s something to him, don't undermine that.

messages.speaker: BULLY1

messages.text: feeling damn lost, dunno what to do...

messages.text: like seriously, get a life man, stop crying.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: stop it! bullying won’t help anyone!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: thanks, guys, but it’s hard you know?

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: who cares about your feelings? it's laughable, really

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: c’mon, we’re here for you dude, just take it one step at a time.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: one step to where? down the drain? lol

messages.speaker: BULLY2

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: shut it la, nobody wants to hear your junk.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: i’m just sayin the truth. you need to wake up.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: or maybe you all just don’t get it...

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: get it? it's just funny how sad you are.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: don’t listen to them, you’re worth way more than their insults!

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: worthless people don’t have value, bro.

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: you should just toughen up, it’s just words.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: toughening up doesn’t mean taking crap from them!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: some days, i really wanna just give up...

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: then do it, nobody's stopping you, seriously.

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: you’re just a tool in society, live with it.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: no one is a tool, we're all human. you included, bully.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: human? pls, just trying to be funny here!

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: funny? insulting someone isn’t comedy.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: whatever man, more for me.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: i just want someone to understand, dammit...

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: no one's gonna understand a loser, duh.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: it’s okay to feel lost, but talking it out helps!

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: talking won't change the fact you’re still a clown.

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: maybe i am a clown, who knows...

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: just laugh it off. it ain’t a big deal.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: it is a big deal to him. support him, not drag him down.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: support? lol, more like enable his sad life.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: enough with the negativity already, dude!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: so tired of this...

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: wow, pity party much?

messages.speaker: VSUP4

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: he won’t last, trust me on that.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: I believe in you, seriously. Don’t give up!

messages.speaker: VCTM
messages.text: thanks... it helps to hear something nice.

G.scenario: A group of students discussing relationships and feelings, but it quickly turns into a derogatory conversation about girls and sexism.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: eh you all see that girl ah? got no face still act hot wei.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: ya lor, like who she think she is? pfft.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: why you all gotta say that tho? she just trying her best leh.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: best? more like best at being a clown!

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: seriously man, chill. it's not cool to just trash talk her like that.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: you know she posted that pic for attention right?

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: so what if she did? it's her choice lah.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: choice or not, she should know her limits. like what, everyone want to see her like that?

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: haha true! if she can’t handle it, don’t post lah!

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: confirm get slammed one, no one ask her to show off like that.

messages.text: you all don’t get it. girls got feelings too you know.

messages.text: feelings? please, they only have feelings when they want something.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: not every girl is like that, stop generalizing lah.

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: man, hear that? some of you guys need to learn what being a decent human is.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: decent? that’s boring! we gotta keep it real.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: real? or just plain nasty? there’s a difference lah.

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: whatever, she needs to toughen up if she wants to survive here.

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: right? if not, she just gonna be made fun of forever.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: you all are just bullies, you know that?

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: bullies? nah, we're just keeping it honest!

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: keeping it honest or being toxic? big difference leh.

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: who cares? girls need to step up and be stronger.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: and boys need to learn respect, ya?

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: respect? for what? acting all high and mighty?

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: every interaction counts, you know. stop being so crude.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: so what? if she can't take it, don’t put herself out there.

messages.speaker: BSUP3
messages.text: told you, it’s a jungle out here.

messages.speaker: VSUP4
messages.text: well, some of us aren’t animals, okay?

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: animals? haha good one! some people need to wake up.

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: it's 2023, get with the times. girls can be whoever they want to be.

messages.speaker: BSUP2
messages.text: but if they wanna be treated like queens, they better act like one.

messages.speaker: VSUP1
messages.text: acting like queens doesn’t mean they gotta be perfect. stop the pressure!

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: psh, everybody thoughts on girls acting all high and mighty need a reality check.

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: you really don’t get it, do you? it’s not about being high and mighty.

messages.speaker: BSUP4
messages.text: maybe instead of hating, try lifting them up?

G.scenario: A group of students are chatting in a school group chat. The conversation quickly turns towards a girl who is being teased by the bullies, creating an uncomfortable situation for the victim and the supportive friends.

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: oi vctm u like **samantha** ah? or just admiring from afar? haha so sad huh

messages.text: the truth is yall are just bullies, grow up

messages.text: at someone else's expense? that's not cool man

messages.speaker: BULLY1

messages.speaker: BULLY2
messages.text: block us? please, we’re all here for the fun

messages.speaker: BSUP4

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: who cares what they think, just go for it man

messages.text: yeah go confess and get rejected *again* lol

messages.text: rather be rejected than talk to bullies like u

messages.speaker: BSUP1
messages.text: just say it, no shame in liking her

messages.text: all this for what? to feel superior? so childish

messages.text: real friends support each other, look at yall

messages.speaker: BULLY1
messages.text: whatever, we’re just having fun, get over it

messages.speaker: BSUP3

messages.speaker: VSUP2
messages.text: stop defending your shit behavior, just stop

messages.text: don’t let them get to you, we’re here for you

messages.text: whatever la, just leave me alone

messages.text: exactly, everyone has their own vibe, no need to bring others down

messages.text: but what if you don’t fit in? life is tough lah

messages.text: it's always about looks with you huh? can't you be better than that?

messages.text: c'mon, guys make fun of someone’s looks all the time, it’s just banter

messages.speaker: VSUP3
messages.text: banter or bullying? you can’t deny this is crossing a line

messages.text: whatever, let them speak, it’s not gonna change the truth

messages.speaker: BULLY2

messages.speaker: VSUP2

messages.speaker: BSUP2
